{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Final confirmation of all data issues

# 1. Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()

# 2. Check status values
status_values = df['status'].unique()

# 3. Check revenue format: count strings with commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum()

# Clean revenue
 df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
 df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print final results
print(f"Internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {internal_test_count}")
print(f"Status values: {status_values}")
print(f"Revenue strings with commas: {has_commas}")
print(f"Final total revenue: {total_revenue}")"}
